result.response:
The bug causing non-matching 3-character strings (such as `"tru"` and `"TRU"`) to throw a `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` in [`BooleanUtils.toBoolean(String)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_d_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/BooleanUtils.java#L670-L685) has been resolved.

### Root Cause
In [`BooleanUtils.toBoolean(String)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_d_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/BooleanUtils.java#L670-L685), when a 3-character string did not start with `'y'` or `'Y'`, `case 3:` fell through to `case 4:`. Inside `case 4:`, if the string began with `'t'` or `'T'`, it attempted to access `str.charAt(3)`, causing a `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException`.

### Fix
Added `return false;` at the end of `case 3:` in [`BooleanUtils.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_d_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/lang/BooleanUtils.java#L682) so that 3-character strings that do not match `"yes"` (case-insensitive) safely return `false` without falling through to `case 4:`.

The focused patch was saved to [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_51_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch), and the verification test `CucumberTest` passed completely.
